---
# The landing page is generated from readme.md at render time -- this file holds
# no content of its own, so the readme stays the single source of truth for both
# GitHub and the published site. Everything below is presentation only.
#
# No `title:` here on purpose: the readme opens with its own h1, and setting one
# would render it twice. `pagetitle` names the browser tab instead.
pagetitle: "Galileo Conference DASDAE Tutorial"
description: "Data and code for the DASDAE fiber-optic sensing tutorial at the 14th EGU Galileo Conference."
format:
  html:
    # yeti is what dascore.org renders in, so the landing page and the docs
    # agree; index.scss layers the logo's palette over it.
    theme: [yeti, index.scss]
    toc: true
    toc-location: right
    toc-title: "On this page"
    anchor-sections: true
    link-external-newwindow: true
    # The readme's fenced bash/python blocks are the setup instructions.
    code-copy: true
    code-overflow: wrap
---

{{< include readme.md >}}
